full_text:
Article 4 (Expenses for Activities to Promote Fair Elections)
(1) Expenses for activities to promote fair elections shall be paid to the Chairperson and non-standing members of the National Election Commission to reimburse expenses incurred in collecting and studying materials concerning fair elections and conducting promotional activities under Article 12 (1) 1 of the Act. <Amended on February 6, 2024>
(2) The persons eligible for expenses for activities to promote fair elections and the amounts payable shall be as specified in the attached Appendix. <Newly Inserted on February 6, 2024>
